reason: The text describes Abraham explicitly separating from his young servants (נְעָרָיו), telling them to remain behind with the donkey while he and Isaac proceed alone to the mountain (וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אַבְרָהָ֜ם אֶל־ נְעָרָ֗יו שְׁבוּ־ לָכֶ֥ם פֹּה֙ עִֽם־ הַחֲמ֔וֹר). The narrative focuses on Abraham's individual obedience to God and his relationship with Isaac, not collaboration between a leader and people. While the servants return with Abraham at the journey's end, they neither participate in nor collaborate on the central action of the narrative. The passage emphasizes separation and individual action, not collective leadership working together.
